verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question to ask of a SaaS project-management tool like Basecamp, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The pack covers only features, pricing, and API docs, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
